known_issue: Residual colour on 014_pair. Raw generated images retained for full-dataset review; no automatic greyscale conversion authorised or applied.
evaluation_scope: Full reviewed dataset; training and evaluation membership labelled. Future unbiased generalisation checks need new photographs.

latest_assessment.notes: This full LoRA run contains substantial hallucinations: many outputs are very far from the requested content. Invented scenes and extra images, changed poses and anatomy, missing main characters, residual colour and inconsistent background handling are material failures. A monochrome conversion would not fix the content errors.
